title: deps: upgrade the 7 React libraries whose latest release declares @types/react, and drop their packageExtensions entries
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzi4PechTRCTBrfxV8W

Follows #37066 (fixes #37015). Maintainer ruling on 2026-11-25: merge #37066 as it is, and handle library upgrades on a separate card. This is that card.

## Background

#37066 adds a `packageExtensions` block to `pnpm-workspace.yaml`. It declares `@types/react` as a peer for 31 libraries whose `.d.ts` files import `react` without declaring it. Each entry becomes a no-op once the library declares the peer itself. Then the entry can be deleted.

## Measured on npm, 2026-11-25 ~02:35Z (seat 3)

Of the 31, **7** declare `@types/react` as a peer in their latest release:

| Library | Locked | Upgrade to | Kind |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lucide-react` | 1.43.0 | ≥1.50.0 (latest 1.79.0) | minor |
| `react-router` | 7.18.5 | latest 7.x (declares `@types/react >=18`) | minor |
| `recharts` | 3.10.1 | 3.11.x | minor |
| `react-hook-form` | 7.85.0 | 7.92.x | minor |
| `@reduxjs/toolkit` | 2.12.0 | 2.15.x | minor |
| `react-resizable-panels` | 4.12.2 | 4.24.x | minor |
| `react-i18next` | 17.0.11 | ≥18.0.1 | **major**; 18.x requires `i18next >=27`, and the repo has 26.4.0, so this is two majors together |

(`i18next` is not one of the 31; it moves only because `react-i18next` 18 requires it. The exact first version that adds the peer was checked for `react-i18next` and `lucide-react` only, on #37066 comment 7148839083. For the others, the locked version was checked to lack it and the latest to have it.)

The other **24 never declare it, not even at their latest release**, so their `packageExtensions` entries stay. That includes `cmdk` and `input-otp`, which are on the console build path.

## Scope

1. Upgrade the minor-version libraries, and delete each one's `packageExtensions` line once the lockfile shows the library declaring the peer itself.
2. `react-i18next` 17 → 18 together with `i18next` 26 → 27. This touches runtime translation (`@object-ui/i18n` and its consumers), so read both changelogs and check the console in a browser. Splitting it into its own PR is fine, but the card's total size still counts toward the Tier H line.
3. Keep #37066's guard test green: `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/react-typings-own-resolution-37015.test.ts`.

## Acceptance

- Each deleted entry's library resolves `@types/react` from its own store directory on a `--config.hoist=false` install (the guard test or the #37066 two-minute check).
- The console build passes on both the hoisting install and the no-hoist install.
- The lockfile still holds exactly one `@types/react` and one `@types/react-dom`.

Blocked by: #37066 (must merge first).
Related: #37015, #37068 (long-term guard), #36777 (Mac acceptance).
